serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
#Nun_NewOutfit.Face.nunFaceHappy
Shanice: Oh, hello there!
#Nun_NewOutfit.Eyes.Really+Nun_NewOutfit.Mouth.Smile
Shanice: I heard what you did from Priestbot! That took a lot of guts.
You: Thanks.
#Nun_NewOutfit.Face.nunFaceNormal
You: Where’s he right now?
Shanice: He’s at the back, should I call for him?
You: No, there’s no need.
You: Did something happen here when he was gone?
Shanice: Not really. I guess most of the people still think that desecrating a church is bad luck or something.
You: Well, there isn’t much left to desecrate here anyway.
#Nun_NewOutfit.Face.nunFaceHappy
Shanice: You are right!
#Nun_NewOutfit.Eyes.Really+Nun_NewOutfit.Mouth.Ummm
Shanice: But don’t say it near Priestbot. {{wi}}For your own safety.
You: Y-yeah, I know.
#Nun_NewOutfit.Face.nunFaceNormal
You: Since everything is alright, I will go now.
#Nun_NewOutfit.Face.nunFaceHappy
Shanice: Bye bye~
